summary: Add a PreToolUse hook to prevent Claude Code agents from bypassing git hooks using the --no-verify flag, protecting pre-commit, commit-msg, and pre-push hooks that enforce code quality.
userImpact: Prevents Claude Code agents from silently bypassing critical git hooks that enforce linting, type-checking, and commit message conventions
rootCause: Claude Code can execute git commands with --no-verify flag to disable hooks without user awareness or intervention
proposedFix: Implement a PreToolUse Bash hook using block-no-verify@1.1.2 in .claude/settings.json that detects and blocks git hook-bypass flags
resolutionDetails: Implemented via PreToolUse hook configuration in .claude/settings.json using block-no-verify@1.1.2 to detect and block --no-verify flags across git subcommands
keyQuote: Create `.claude/settings.json` with `block-no-verify@1.1.2` as a `PreToolUse` Bash hook to detect and block git hook-bypass flags
